title: Pro-Sonko supporters gather at Sonko’s Dakar home; police disperse the crowd
location: Dakar, outside Ousmane Sonko’s home. The article does not name a neighborhood or street; its separate reference to police blocking a march on major roads has no separate count.
scope: Local. The report covers a gathering at Sonko’s home and police preventing a supporters’ march on major roads; whether those were one site or linked actions is unresolved.
participants_original: Teranga News reports that thousands of supporters arrived early that morning. This is a qualitative description, not a counted estimate; the report gives no separate count for people at the home and people affected by the blocked march.
threshold_50_evidence: The qualitative “thousands” description supports a crowd plausibly above 50 at the home, but no exact or independent count is available and the broader road deployment is not a separate attendance count.

participants.summary: The article qualitatively says thousands arrived early; it gives no exact count and no separate number for the home gathering and blocked march.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The “thousands” description is a qualitative indication above 50 at the home, not an exact or independently corroborated count.

protester_violence.summary: The body does not establish violence by the supporters; no affirmative code is assigned.

state_response.summary: Police deployment and tear-gas dispersal support crowd_dispersal=yes; the article mentions arrests without a count, supporting arrests=yes. Accommodation, beatings, ignore, killings and firearm shootings are not reported as outcomes and remain unknown. Reported injuries do not establish beatings; tear gas is not coded as firearm shooting.

eligibility.summary: A public gathering is reported, but the article’s solidarity framing does not establish a specific demand to Senegal’s state. Eligibility remains pending state-target evidence.

notes: The article body was opened once (web ref turn2790view0). The preserved outcome says the returned lines included the main article at lines 186–196 of 251, byline/date at line 188, author at line 203, title and footer; no images were opened and no HTTP status was exposed. The preserved correction supplies the verified receipt hash. Keep the crowd at the home distinct from any uncounted march blocked on roads; police response alone does not establish a demand to the state.
